title: Johan Skov Bundgaard, MD, PhD Fellow
text:
I’m an MD and PhD fellow at the Copenhagen Hospital Biobank. My work sits at the intersection of cardiology, immunology, and genetics, with a PhD project focused on the genetics of fibrosis.
Alongside research, I care about health policy and how evidence moves into practice. I occasionally write chronicles and commentary—often about digital health, medical education, and the Nordic health systems—for outlets such as Ugeskrift for Læger, Dagens Medicin, Berlingske, Politiken and Nakorsanut.
